description: This is a PHP interface defining the contract for a Cookie Jar implementation within the Guzzle HTTP client library. It specifies methods for handling cookies such as adding, extracting, and removing cookies, as well as converting the jar to an array.

methods.name: withCookieHeader
methods.description: Creates a request object with the appropriate Cookie header set based on the stored cookies.

methods.name: extractCookies
methods.description: Parses cookies from an HTTP response and stores them in the cookie jar.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the jar.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes cookies from the jar based on optional domain, path, and name filters.

methods.name: clearSessionCookies
methods.description: Removes session cookies that do not have expiration or discard flags.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all cookies in the jar as an array.
